topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic on the initiation and resolution of inflammation and outlines how previously introduced immune components fit together.

topics.label: Innate Immune Recognition: PAMPs, DAMPs, and Pattern Recognition Receptors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system detects infection and tissue damage using molecular patterns and diverse pattern recognition receptors.

topics.label: Cellular Recruitment and Systemic Inflammatory Responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how activated sentinel cells direct leukocyte trafficking into tissues, initiate lymphatic transport, and can trigger severe systemic pathology like sepsis.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the processes by which inflammation is resolved, damaged tissue is repaired, and chronic responses such as granulomas are formed.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming topic on the complement system.
